name: diag-pins
summary: DIAGNOSTIC: VCP E0-E9 GET report power state plus live pin registers (backlight enable, VLCD, standby power, PM wake status). Use INSTEAD of diag-probes
status: encodings verified by disassembly; hardware test pending

edits.asm: E2 -> pin reg 0x426 (bit6 = backlight enable output)
E5 -> pin reg 0x434 (bit4 VLCD, bits6/7 indicator)

notes: E0 pwr, E1 cnt, E2 RIU 0x426 (bit6 = backlight enable driven by sub_245919/sub_245860; 1 = on), E4 flg, E5 RIU 0x434 (bit4 = panel VLCD; bits 6/7 = PM51-driven indicator pins), E7 RIU 0x44A (bits 7,6,2,1 cleared by the real power-save path sub_23D6AA, set again on power-on), E8 RIU 0x3AA (PM wake/status, read once at boot by sub_2414AE), E9 rws. Register reads go through the uncached RIU window 0xA0000000 + 2*reg, as the bootloader does. Shares sites with diag-probes; apply one or the other.
